vishiatchoudhary-reels-reels-setup.description: Use when setting up, installing or onboarding the reels studio (github.com/VishiATChoudhary/reels), when a user or agent wants to start making story reels with it, or when its setup is broken (missing whisper-cli, model, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, node deps). Clones, installs, verifies, and stars the repo (one [Y/n] prompt).
